subject: ARLO SEO — Monthly — October 2026
html:
ARLO SEO — Month 4 Review (October 2026)

Covering 2026-10-01 through 2026-10-31, reported 2026-11-01. This is the first month past the original 12-week-strategy.md window (kickoff 2026-07-04 + 12 weeks ≈ 2026-09-26, reviewed and extended on 2026-10-01) — the plan's Week 9–12 items are now the ongoing content backlog rather than a window with its own deadline.

Honest frame, stated up front: askarlo.app is a 4-month-old domain (SE Ranking Domain Trust 6, flat this month after ticking up every month since kickoff) on a 6–12 month organic ramp. Per 12-week-strategy.md's own KPI ladder, these are still leading-indicator months — indexation, first tracked rankings, off-page trust signals, human blockers cleared — not leads. Measured against that bar, this is the fourth straight month the metrics outside this routine's control (rankings, backlinks, the human-gated off-page/GSC/catalog.ts decisions) came up completely empty, while content execution inside its control stayed on pace with zero regressions and caught three more real, previously-unflagged bugs. Zero rankings after 4 months on KD 9–31 terms is still inside the plan's own stated range for a brand-new domain — but the same three cheap, human-only blockers flagged in Month 2 and Month 3 are now four months old, and a fourth destination-catalog ETA (shareable_dashboard, due this exact month) just joined them as newly overdue.

Leads / CPL (GA4 conversions, proxy metric)

Pending — unchanged for a 4th straight month. GA4 (G-CP22NBPLFP) has been firing since 2026-07-04, but this sandbox still has no outbound GA4 Reporting API access, so conversion counts can't be pulled from here. By design this stays a non-goal until pages actually rank — and with 0 of 22 tracked keywords ranked anywhere after 4 months (confirmed via a fresh daily pull, 2026-10-01→11-01: average position sat at exactly 100, the not-ranked floor, on every single day), that condition still hasn't been met. A human checking the GA4 console directly would finally close a 4-month-old "pending," independent of the ranking question.

What's working

  • Content execution held pace and quality for a 4th straight month. 14 sessions in October: 7 shipped code changes (a site-wide OG/Twitter-card + JSON-LD copy-paste bug affecting 4 pages and a duplicate WebPage schema block on all 5 /compare/[slug] pages, plus the original audit's P0 #5 pricing-schema gap, all fixed 10-08; a wrong breadcrumb JSON-LD on the /destinations hub, 10-12; a dead /services link in llms.txt, 10-15; a visually-hidden semantic <table> of the pricing tiers for AI/search extractability per geo-ai.md #16, 10-19; leftover "custom build"/agency-copy headings replaced on the shared persona-page template per the original audit's P2 #16, 10-22; the question-form H2 rewrite from geo-ai.md #10, trialed on one persona page 10-26 then extended to all 6, 10-29) plus 6 weekly-pulse/verification sessions with no code changes because the content backlog was genuinely re-confirmed exhausted. Every shipped session was build-gated (npm run build clean, same 9 pre-existing Vercel-only prerender failures every time, not a regression) with zero shipped regressions across the project's entire history. GitHub Actions: 59/59 "SEO Report Email" runs green all-time, including every run this month.
  • Three more real, previously-unflagged bugs caught and fixed from live evidence rather than from stale audit prose — the OG/Twitter/schema copy-paste bug, the /destinations hub breadcrumb, and the dead llms.txt link were all found by reading current source directly, the same discipline that corrected two stale findings in September.
  • sxo.md (the last of the eight static audits not yet re-verified against current code this cycle) was fully re-checked item-by-item on 10-01, the very first day of the month — 7 of its 8 priority items confirmed already shipped or non-issues in current code, leaving only #7 (a second case study/testimonial) open, and that one is human-only (needs a real client quote, nothing to fabricate). All eight static audits are now re-verified against current source at least once.
  • Month 3's two named-but-undelivered content items turned out to be one, not two — checking src/content/blog/posts/us/how-to-set-up-a-claude-mcp-server.md directly on 10-01 confirmed the claude mcp server pillar page has actually been live since 2026-08-06; the Month 3/4 goal language restating it as outstanding was itself stale and was corrected in the worklog the same day it was caught, the same class of self-correction this routine has applied before.
  • The FOCUS keyword cluster keeps validating the thesis even with zero rank movement: claude mcp server held at 910/mo and mcp connector at 880/mo across every re-pull this month — neither tracked term has softened in over four months of consecutive checks, even though the connector matrix (5/5) and comparison hub (5/5) both remain fully built out against current demand with no new human-independent page to ship.

What's not working

  • Zero rank movement for a fourth consecutive month. Fresh live pull this session (PROJECT_getPositionHistory, site_id 12704162, 2026-10-01→11-01, daily): average position sat at exactly 100 (SE Ranking's not-ranked floor) on every single day — 0 of 22 tracked keywords have registered a measurable position at any point since tracking began on 2026-08-01, now three full months running. Month 4's goal (first position for any keyword) was not met for a 3rd time.
  • Off-page link acquisition has now been completely flat for over 4 months. Fresh pull this session (DATA_getBacklinksSummary, domain mode): still exactly 3 backlinks / 2 referring domains, unchanged since 2026-09-10 — both referring domains remain the same futurlabs.dev sister-site cross-link, not earned links. Off-page Phase 1 (6 self-serve directory/registry listings, each a ~15–30-minute web form) stays 0 of 6, now 3 months past its original Week-4 target, with no sandbox path to self-serve any of them (no outbound HTTP access from this environment).
  • Domain Trust stalled this month after three straight monthly increments. DATA_getDomainAuthority this session: still 6 (unchanged from the 2026-10-01 reading) — the 5→6→6 pattern that had ticked up every month since kickoff didn't repeat in October, the first flat reading since tracking began.
  • Every human-decision blocker from the Month 4 goal is still open, and one more item just joined the overdue pile. src/lib/connectors/catalog.ts re-checked byte-for-byte: all 9 gated connectors (shopify — April 2026 ETA, 7 months overdue; meta_ads/linkedin_ads/meta_pages — May 2026, 6 months overdue; tiktok_ads/stripe — June 2026, 5 months overdue; hubspot/mailerlite — July 2026, 4 months overdue; mailchimp — August 2026, 3 months overdue) remain coming_soon, unchanged for a 2nd straight month. New this month: src/lib/destinations/catalog.ts's shareable_dashboard entry carried an "October 2026" ETA flagged as the one destination due this exact month — it is now 2026-11-01 and the entry is still coming_soon, so every single coming_soon destination-catalog entry (power_bi July, excel August, snowflake September, now shareable_dashboard October) is simultaneously overdue, the same pattern the connector catalog hit in September. The dormant 6-persona route.ts scaffold (open since 2026-07-30) and GSC sitemap submission (open since kickoff, 2026-07-04, now 4 full months) are both still unresolved.
  • AI-engine visibility still has no baseline after 4 full months. PROJECT_listLlmEngines this session: still an empty list — the AI Result Tracker has never had a single LLM engine configured on this project, so the ongoing GEO/AEO investment (FAQPage schema, the semantic pricing table shipped this month, the question-form heading rewrite now live on all 6 persona pages) still has nothing measurable to show. This remains a one-time human setup step in the SE Ranking console, not something another session can self-serve.
  • The ChatGPT-assistant-column connector variant (the one Month-3/4 content item that wasn't a stale restatement) is still blocked on the same open human check flagged since 2026-08-06, unchanged.

Numbers vs. Month-4 targets (set 2026-10-01)

KPIMonth-4 targetActualStatus
First measured SERP position≥1 of 22 tracked keywords (carried over unmet twice)0 of 22 — avg position flat at 100 every day, 2026-10-01–11-01❌ Not met
Off-page Phase 1 + GSC submission≥2 of 6 directory/registry listings shipped; GSC sitemap submitted0 of 6 — still 3 backlinks / 2 referring domains, unchanged since 09-10; GSC submission not confirmed completed❌ Not met
Human decisions closedcatalog.ts pass (9 of 9 overdue), persona-route scaffold0 of 2 — both still open; destinations catalog gained a 4th overdue entry (shareable_dashboard)❌ Not met
claude mcp server pillar + ChatGPT columnShip the pillar page; ship the ChatGPT column if unblockedPillar page confirmed already live since 2026-08-06 (goal was a stale restatement, corrected 10-01); ChatGPT column still blocked, unchanged⚠️ Already satisfied, not new progress
Re-verify sxo.mdRe-check against current source before treating findings as new workDone in full on 10-01; closed except item #7 (human-gated 2nd testimonial)✅ Met
Leads/CPL proxyStays "pending" unless rankings appearPending — no rankings appeared, GA4 still unqueryable from this sandbox✅ As designed
Pages/fixes shipped (quality bar ~2/wk)~8–9 over the month7 build-gated code-shipping sessions + 6 verification/pulse sessions over 14 total sessions✅ On pace
Domain Trustn/a (directional signal)6 → 6 (flat, first non-increase since kickoff)🟡 Flat
CI healthn/a (directional signal)59/59 "SEO Report Email" runs green, all-time✅ Green

Score — Month 4 goal: Missed (2 of 6 measurable KPIs met: sxo.md fully re-verified on day one of the month; Leads/CPL correctly stayed "pending." The claude mcp server pillar item turned out to already be satisfied from before Month 4 began — a stale goal corrected, not a fresh delivery — so it counts as neither a miss nor new progress this month.)

Content execution has now stayed on pace for 4 straight months with zero shipped regressions and three more real bugs caught and fixed from live evidence this month alone — the routine itself keeps working as designed, and every static audit in the repo has now been re-verified against current code at least once. But every metric outside its control came up empty for a 4th consecutive month: 0 of 22 keywords have ever registered a position, the referring-domain count hasn't moved since before Month 3, Domain Trust stalled after three straight monthly ticks, and all of this month's human-decision blockers are not just still open but joined by a newly-lapsed destinations-catalog ETA. This is still inside the plan's own stated 6–12 month ramp for a brand-new domain — but the same three cheap, fast, human-only items (GSC submission, 6 directory listings, a catalog.ts status pass) that this report flagged in Months 2 and 3 are now 4 months overdue on tasks that take a human minutes, not months.

Adjustments for next month

  • Stop re-logging the off-page/GSC/catalog.ts blockers as if they were new findings — this is the 4th consecutive monthly report flagging the exact same 3 human-only items (30 minutes of browser time across 6 self-serve forms, one GSC sitemap submission, one status pass on 9 overdue connector ETAs). Re-verifying "still open" every month with no human update attached adds confirmation, not information.
  • The destinations catalog now has the same problem the connector catalog hit in September: every single coming_soon entry (power_bi, excel, snowflake, shareable_dashboard) is overdue. A human pass across both catalogs at once — mark each entry shipped/re-dated/removed — would resolve two flagged items in one sitting instead of one.
  • If the ChatGPT-assistant-column human check ever resolves, that's the one remaining named content item left over from Month 3 worth shipping promptly; everything else in the FOCUS cluster is confirmed exhausted for an 8th-plus straight session.
  • Set up at least one LLM engine in the SE Ranking AI Result Tracker console — a one-time human action that would finally give 4+ months of GEO/AEO investment (FAQPage schema, the semantic pricing table, question-form headings) a measurable baseline instead of zero visibility data.

Goal — Month 5 (November 2026)

1) First measured SERP position for any of the 22 tracked keywords — carried over unmet for a 3rd time; the bar stays at ≥1 rather than escalating, since forcing a higher target wouldn't change Google's own crawl/index timeline. 2) Off-page Phase 1: ≥2 of the 6 directory/registry listings actually shipped by a human, and GSC sitemap submission actually completed — flagged for a 4th consecutive month as the highest-leverage, lowest-effort open items on the entire plan. 3) A combined human pass on both src/lib/connectors/catalog.ts (9 of 9 overdue) and src/lib/destinations/catalog.ts (4 of 4 coming_soon entries now overdue) — mark each entry shipped, re-dated, or removed — plus a decision on the dormant persona-route scaffold. 4) Ship the ChatGPT-assistant-column connector variant if the 2026-08-06 human check has resolved; otherwise this item carries over unchanged. 5) Configure at least one LLM engine in SE Ranking's AI Result Tracker so AI-visibility finally has a measurable baseline. 6) Leads/CPL proxy stays "pending" through Month 5 unless rankings actually appear; if they do, this is the trigger to start pulling GA4 conversions as the real goal metric per the strategy doc's own instruction.
